info.title: AquaTome smart plugs
info.description:
Smart plugs on a reader's tanks: Tuya (Smart Life) and eWeLink (Sonoff) power strips, reached through each maker's cloud with keys only the server holds. Design, linking and safety rules: docs/smart-plugs.md. A plug on a tank is a device record with kind "plug" (protocols/tanks.schema.json).

Every path but the callback needs a signed-in AquaTome account, as protocols/accounts.openapi.json describes: the app sends Authorization: Bearer <token>, the site its session cookie; changes from a browser must come from https://aquatome.com pages (403 cross_site otherwise). With accounts off, every path is 404 accounts_off.

Without a maker's keys on the server, its paths are 503 not_configured and GET /api/v1/plugs lists it as not available; the other maker is unaffected.

Errors are {"error": "<code>"} with the status listed. The server switches an outlet only when asked to by this API, and clients ask only on a reader's tap (docs/smart-plugs.md): nothing switches on its own, nothing is queued or retried. `on` sets an outlet's state; it never toggles, so the same request twice does no harm.

get.summary: The makers this account can link or has linked, and the linked plugs as they are now
get.description: Each maker is listed with its state; a maker that can't be reached (or doesn't answer within 8 seconds) shows its problem and no plugs, and the others still list theirs. The state (online, on) comes from the maker's cloud, at most 15 seconds old (the server keeps a link's list that long, to stay within the makers' call limits; a switch through this API refreshes it). Clients ask when the reader opens or refreshes a screen, never on a timer. 60 requests a minute per account.

post.summary: Start linking (or linking again) a maker's account: the maker's sign-in page to open
post.description:
The app sends `verifier`'s SHA-256 (hex) as `challenge`; it opens `url` in an authentication session (ASWebAuthenticationSession) with callback scheme `aquatome`. The site sends no challenge and opens `url` in the same tab. The sign-in page is good for 10 minutes and one use.

Linking again (tokens expired: the list's `relink`, or a switch's 409 relink) is the same request; the new tokens replace the old ones only once the link is finished.

403.description: Error: cross_site, not_available (the maker doesn't yet let every account link: docs/smart-plugs.md)

challenge.description: The app: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of a random verifier it keeps until it finishes the link.

delete.summary: Unlink a maker's account: its tokens are deleted and its plugs no longer listed
delete.description: Plug records on tanks stay (they sync with the tanks); they show as not linked until the maker is linked again. Where the maker can, AquaTome's access is revoked there too (eWeLink: DELETE /v2/user/oauth/token). Also done when the AquaTome account is deleted.

post.summary: The app finishes a link: the tokens the callback holds go to this account
post.description: With the callback's `ticket` (one use, 5 minutes) and the `verifier` whose SHA-256 the app sent to start the link, from the account that started it. Replaces an earlier link's tokens (linking again).

400.description: Error: bad_request, bad_ticket (unknown, used, expired, another account's, or the verifier doesn't match)

get.summary: Where the maker's sign-in page sends the reader back (not called by clients)
get.description:
`state` is the server's, signed: it names the account that started the link, whether the app or the site did, and expires after 10 minutes. The callback always redirects, even for a bad state, an error or a cancel, so the app's sheet closes and the site's tab doesn't end on raw JSON: the app to aquatome://plugs?provider=<provider>&result=<linked|cancelled|failed>[&ticket=<ticket>], the site to its "Bể của tôi" page with the same query (no ticket).

Nothing is linked to an account the reader didn't sign in to here, so a sign-in link sent by someone else can't attach the reader's maker account to theirs:

- The site: the callback links only if the session cookie (sent on this top-level request) is the account in `state`; otherwise result=failed.

- The app: the callback exchanges the maker's code (eWeLink's lasts 30 seconds) and holds the tokens for 5 minutes, unlinked; it redirects with result=linked and a one-time `ticket`. The link is made only by POST …/link/complete from the account in `state`, with the verifier whose SHA-256 started the link.

eWeLink sends the reader back only after a successful sign-in: a reader who gives up just closes the sheet (the app's cancel) or the tab.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: eWeLink: the account's region, which picks its API host.

302.description: Back to the app or the site, with the result.

post.summary: Set one outlet on or off; the outlet as the plug then reports it
post.description: Sent once to the maker's cloud. Then the server reads the outlet back, at most every 600 ms (eWeLink allows a call per 500 ms) for up to 3 seconds, until the plug reports the state asked for. `confirmed` says whether it did; `on` is what the plug reported last (null if it couldn't be read). Clients show the switch as `on` says, never as asked; unconfirmed, they read the list again once (GET /api/v1/plugs) and never send the switch again on their own. 30 switches a minute per account. Not retried by the server.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: The maker's device id (a plug's `id` in GET /api/v1/plugs).

200.description: Sent; the outlet as the plug reports it now.

confirmed.description: The plug reported the state asked for within 3 seconds.

404.description: Error: accounts_off, unknown_provider, not_linked, no_such_plug (not one of this account's), no_such_outlet

409.description: Error: offline, relink (the maker's tokens expired: link again)

502.description: Error: maker_error (the maker's cloud refused, failed or didn't answer: the outlet's state is unknown, and it may have switched. Read the list again before switching again)

bearer.description: The app: the token from a sign-in with client "app" (protocols/accounts.openapi.json).

cookie.name: __Host-aq_session
cookie.description: The site: set by a sign-in with client "web".

id.description: tuya or ewelink; clients skip ids they don't know.

available.description: This account can link it now (the server has its keys, and the maker lets every account link or this one is allowed).

problem.description: Linked, but its plugs couldn't be listed: relink (tokens expired: link again), unreachable (the maker's cloud failed or didn't answer), quota (AquaTome's calls to this maker are used up for now).

code.description: The maker's switch code, stable for the plug and kept in plug records on tanks. Tuya: the switch's code (switch, switch_1…, switch_usb1…). eWeLink: "switch" for a single-outlet switch (params.switch); for one with several outlets, the outlet's number from 0, as text ("0", "1"…; params.switches[].outlet).

name.description: The name the maker's app gives the outlet, if any.

on.description: As the plug reports it; null when it isn't known.

id.description: The maker's device id: a plug record's remoteId.

name.description: As named in the maker's app.
